description: Deterministic pose-studio seed + complete joint rotations for the three.ws mannequin, picked from the in-repo preset library by matching natural-language prompt tokens against preset labels, IDs, and groups. Returns the preset id, the full Euler-rotation pose map (radians), a sha256-derived seed, and a previewUrl on three.ws/pose. Paid: $0.001 USDC.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the pose, e.g. "warrior stance", "wave hello", "sitting cross-legged".

name: get_pose_seed
title: Pose seed ($0.001)
